home.heroTitle: A free mock exam for ISTQB {{name}}
home.heroLead: {{questions}} original questions written from the v{{version}} syllabus. Every option carries a reason — the right one and the wrong ones — in Turkish and in English. No account, no fee, and nothing you do here leaves your device.
home.blueprintCaption: {{total}} questions spread across {{chapters}} chapters in the proportions ISTQB publishes.
home.modesLead: Study builds the ground, practice drills it, the mock exam measures it. You can start anywhere.
home.startHereBody: If this is your first visit, start with study: it takes the {{total}} learning objectives one at a time, each with a card to read and questions drawn only from that objective. If you already know the material, sit a mock exam first and find out where you stand.
home.startHereStorage: Your progress is saved in this browser only, never on a server. Clearing the browser's data, or closing a private window, deletes it.
home.resumeTitle: You have a session in progress

home.studyLead: Take one learning objective at a time: read its card, then answer questions drawn only from that objective.
home.studyTime: No limit. Stop and come back whenever you like.
home.studyAnswers: Shown the moment you choose one, with the reason for every option.
home.studyScore: Tracked per objective, so you can see which ones you have learned. No pass or fail.
home.practiceLead: Pick a chapter or the whole syllabus, pick how many questions, and work through them.
home.practiceTime: No limit, and no clock on screen.
home.practiceAnswers: Your choice: straight after each question, or all at the end.
home.practiceScore: Out of the questions you picked, with a review of every one.
home.examLead: {{count}} questions drawn from all {{chapters}} chapters in the official proportions, against the clock.
home.examTime: {{minutes}} minutes, counting down. It submits itself when time runs out.
home.examAnswers: Hidden until you submit, exactly as in the real exam.
home.examScore: {{pass}} of {{total}} points passes. Then a full review, question by question.
home.officialBody: The official sample exams, with their answer keys, are free from their publishers. Their licence does not let anyone republish them, so you will not find them in this pool — but you will find where to download them.

home.blueprintPointsMixed: Not every question is worth the same: {{list}}, {{total}} points in all.

myData.title: Your data
myData.intro: Your progress — sessions, answers, learned objectives and the repetition deck — is stored only in this browser, and nothing is sent anywhere. To keep it safe, or to carry it to another device, download a copy and load it there.
myData.exportBody: One JSON file holding everything this browser keeps for you. It goes only where you save it.
myData.exportFailed: The file could not be created — your browser may be blocking storage.
myData.importBody: Nothing on this device is deleted. Where the file and this browser hold the same record, the newer one is kept, so loading the same file twice changes nothing.
myData.preview: Saved on {{date}}. Sessions: {{sessions}} · answers: {{answers}} · objective records: {{objectives}} · repetition cards: {{cards}}.
myData.versionWarning: The questions have been updated since this file was saved. Your progress still loads — a question that has changed since shows its current text.
myData.imported: Loaded. New records: {{added}} · updated from the file: {{updated}} · kept from this browser because they were newer: {{kept}}.
myData.importFailed: The file could not be loaded into this browser — your browser may be blocking storage. Nothing was changed.
myData.errorNotJson: This file is not readable JSON. Choose the file this site downloaded for you.
myData.errorNotBackup: This is not a progress file from this site.
myData.errorNewerFormat: This file was made by a newer version of this site. Reload the page and try again.
myData.errorNewerSchema: This file was made by a newer version of this site. Reload the page and try again.
myData.errorInvalidRows: This file is damaged: some of its records are incomplete, so none of it was loaded.
myData.storageTitle: Does this browser keep your progress?
myData.storagePersistent: Yes. This browser has agreed to keep this site's data until you clear it yourself. A downloaded copy is still the only way to move it to another device.
myData.storageBestEffort: For now. This browser saves your progress but has not promised to keep it: it may delete it when the device runs low on space, some browsers delete the data of a site that has not been visited for a while, and a private window deletes it when it closes. You can ask it to keep the data; a downloaded copy is the safe answer either way.
myData.storageUnknown: This browser saves your progress but does not say whether it will keep it. Some browsers delete the data of a site that has not been visited for a while, and a private window deletes it when it closes. Keep a downloaded copy to be safe.
myData.storageUnavailable: No. This browser is not saving anything for this site: its storage does not open here, which happens when site data is blocked in the browser's settings and in some private windows. The app needs it to run: allow site data for this site, or open it in a normal window.
myData.storageAsk: Ask the browser to keep my data
myData.storageGranted: The browser agreed to keep this site's data.
myData.storageRefused: The browser did not agree. Browsers decide this themselves; keep a downloaded copy to be safe.

process.title: Taking the exam in Turkey
process.intro: How a candidate in Turkey sits an ISTQB exam through the Turkish Testing Board (TTB), from registration to the certificate. Everything here was read from TTB's and ISTQB's own pages on {{date}}. Their rules and prices can change without notice, so the linked page always decides.
process.register1: You buy the exam in TTB's online shop. TTB then e-mails you the free slots and you pick a day and time.
process.register2: You must book your exam date within 1 year of registering, or you lose the right and register again.
process.register3: CTFL has no prerequisite and no training is required. CT-AI requires the CTFL certificate.
process.register4: You pay by bank transfer, at the latest 15 days before the exam, or by Visa, Mastercard or Amex. The e-archive invoice is issued against the T.C. kimlik number you give at registration.
process.register5: The list price is 5,950 ₺ + 20% KDV for CTFL and for CT-AI. On {{date}} the shop showed a sale price of 4,700 ₺ + KDV, with no end date. TTB's English shop showed 98 USD + VAT instead.
process.register6: If your native language is not Turkish, tell TTB in writing when you register: you get the English paper with 25% extra time. TTB says this is not optional. ISTQB's own page says a candidate "is entitled to apply for" the extension.
process.examDayTitle: The exam: online, with a proctor
process.examDay1: TTB's exam pages list the exam as remote online: you sit it on the Mettl platform, from your own computer, at the time you booked. TTB also mentions in-class exams on set dates and in-person exams on request. A proctor watches you through your computer's camera and your smartphone's camera, and the session is recorded.
process.examDay2: The access e-mail arrives at the latest 3 days before the exam, with a link to test your computer. No reminder is sent: if the e-mail does not come, contact TTB.
process.examDay3: You need a computer with a camera and a microphone, a charged smartphone, a stable connection, the current Chrome and the Mettl Secure Browser, which asks you to close your other applications. TTB advises against a work computer.
process.examDay4: Keep an ID card, passport or driving licence with you; at entry you photograph your face and your ID.
process.examDay5: Forbidden: breaks or leaving the screen, food, drink and tobacco, a second screen, headphones, a smart watch, a dictionary, a calculator, paper and pen, reading questions aloud, screenshots and noting questions. An erasable board is allowed if it is blank at the start and the end.
process.examDay6: The chat with the proctor is for technical problems only. Time lost to a technical problem before the start does not count: the clock starts when the proctor starts the exam.
process.paper1: TTB says its online exam has the same number of questions, the same time and the same pass mark as its in-class exam.
process.paper2: CTFL and CT-AI are in Turkish and English, both on the same screen, so you can read each question in either language.
process.paper3: At TTB, a wrong answer costs nothing: "Wrong answers do not delete correct answers."
process.result1: The result comes by e-mail on the same day. You can ask TTB for a summary of your result by topic; the questions themselves are not shared.
process.result2: If you pass, an English e-certificate comes by e-mail the same day; it can be verified through a link on it. ISTQB says Foundation Level certificates are valid for life.
process.result3: Being listed on ISTQB's Successful Candidate Register is your choice: send TTB's signed form to scr@turkishtestingboard.org.
process.result4: An appeal is made within 15 days of the result, and is answered within one month.
process.retake1: A CTFL retake (the 2nd to the 4th attempt) costs 2,975 ₺ + KDV. On {{date}} TTB's shop listed no retake for CT-AI; ask TTB.
process.retake2: TTB says there is no limit on attempts, but that under ISTQB rules you can sit an exam only as many times as there are question sets, a number it does not publish; if that is not enough, you can register with another exam provider. ISTQB's own exam page says you may sit an exam "as many times as necessary".
process.retake3: You may postpone once, by e-mail at least 7 days before the exam; later, you pay 50% of the fee to sit it.
process.retake4: Cancelling by e-mail at least 7 days before refunds the full fee; later, half of it.
process.ctai1: This site teaches CT-AI v2.0. Through TTB, the exam is still the v1.0 (2021) paper until 21 October 2027, and its scoring differs from v2.0's. Check which version your exam date falls under before you study.
process.notFound1: The TTB pages we read do not say whether there is a printed certificate, whether you must wait between attempts, or how much a CT-AI retake costs. We do not guess: ask TTB at certification@turkishtestingboard.org.
